info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Content Management
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Content Management.** Content CRUD and versioning, content types and schema sync, variants, relations, comments, layouts and the Schema Registry connection.

get.summary: List content types with optional search and content counts

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by content type ID or name

200.description: Page of content types, each with its full schemas and the number of content items using it.

get.summary: Get all content types as a compact summary with counts (for dashboard/sidebar)

200.description: All content types of the organization (id, name, icon, count), sorted by id. Cached 2 min.

get.summary: Get content type by ID with schemas, content count, and status breakdown

200.description: The content type with its schemas, total content count and per-status counts. Cached 2 min.

put.summary: Create or update content type (upsert by ID)

200.description: The stored content type (without counts). `syncedAt` is stamped on every upsert.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete content type (fails if content still references it)

200.description: Deletion acknowledgement. Returns 409 instead when content items still use the type.

get.summary: Report which existing content of this type conforms to its current schema

200.description: Conformance report computed on demand. Up to 2000 items are re-validated; `truncated` says whether the report is partial.

get.summary: Resolve the effective schema after inheritance (extends / mixins / fieldOverrides)

200.description: The flattened schema plus per-field lineage and the `abstract` flag.

post.summary: Enable a content type for this organization (sidebar, content creation)

200.description: The content type with `settings.disabled` cleared.

post.summary: Disable a content type for this organization (hidden from sidebar and content creation; existing content is kept)

200.description: The content type with `settings.disabled = true`.

get.summary: List content with filters and pagination

parameters.name: contentTypeId
parameters.description: Filter by single content type ID (backward-compatible)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Full-text search in slug and content data

parameters.name: contentTypeIds
parameters.description: Filter by multiple content type IDs (comma-separated)

parameters.name: hasBeenPublished
parameters.description: Only items that have been published at least once

parameters.name: typeFilters
parameters.description: Content-type-specific filters as JSON string — keys are data field names, values are filter criteria

200.description: Page of content items, each with a compact content type reference and its author. When `includeFacets=true` the envelope additionally carries a `facets` object (see GET /manage/content/facets).

post.summary: Create content (emits content.beforeCreate / content.afterCreate events)

201.description: The created content item (status `draft`, version 1, slug auto-generated and disambiguated when not supplied).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Validate content data against its type schema (dry run — does not save)

200.description: Validation outcome. Always 200 — a schema violation is reported in `data.errors`, not as an HTTP error.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Preview the unique slug for given data/desired slug (does not save)

200.description: The slug that would be assigned, already disambiguated within org + type + locale.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Bulk publish multiple content items (returns per-item results)

201.description: One result per requested id, in request order. Individual failures do not fail the request.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Bulk unpublish multiple content items (returns per-item results)

201.description: One result per requested id, in request order. Items that were not published fail individually.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Bulk archive multiple content items (returns per-item results)

201.description: One result per requested id, in request order.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Bulk delete multiple content items (returns per-item results)

201.description: One result per requested id, in request order. Without `force=true`, items still referenced by others fail individually.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

put.summary: Reorder content items by updating sort_order values

200.description: Acknowledgement that the new order was persisted.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get facet counts for content list sidebar (cached 2 min)

parameters.name: contentTypeId
parameters.description: Filter by single content type ID (backward-compatible)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Full-text search in slug and content data

parameters.name: contentTypeIds
parameters.description: Filter by multiple content type IDs (comma-separated)

parameters.name: hasBeenPublished
parameters.description: Only items that have been published at least once

parameters.name: typeFilters
parameters.description: Content-type-specific filters as JSON string — keys are data field names, values are filter criteria

200.description: Global facets plus — when exactly one content type is selected — the type-specific facets derived from its x-filter annotations.

get.summary: Get filter definitions for all content types with x-filter annotations

200.description: One entry per content type that declares at least one x-filter annotation.

get.summary: Get content-type-specific filter definitions from x-filter schema annotations (cached 10 min)

200.description: Filter definitions for the requested content type, sorted by priority (lowest first).

get.summary: Get content by ID with type, author, and recent versions

200.description: The content item with its full content type, author/editor/publisher references and the 5 newest version snapshots.

put.summary: Update content (creates version snapshot, emits events)

200.description: The updated content item with its incremented `version`.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete content (emits content.beforeDelete — Pro plugins can prevent)

200.description: Deletion acknowledgement. Dangling references in other items are scrubbed asynchronously as part of the delete.

post.summary: Publish content (emits content.beforePublish — Pro plugins can prevent)

201.description: The published content item. `altWarnings` is present only when referenced images lack alt text — advisory, publishing still succeeded.

post.summary: Unpublish content (only published content can be unpublished)
Archive content (moves it out of active lists; restorable via unarchive)
Unarchive content back to draft

201.description: The content item restored to status `draft`.

get.summary: Get content version history (CE: max 10 versions)

200.description: All retained version snapshots, newest first.

post.summary: Restore a previous version

201.description: The content item after the restore — a new version snapshot labelled "Restored from vN" is created.

get.summary: Get outgoing references for a content item

200.description: Relation rows with the referenced item expanded, ordered by `sortOrder`.

put.summary: Set references for a field on a content item (replaces existing)

200.description: Acknowledgement that the field's relations were replaced.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get incoming references (where-used) for a content item

200.description: Relation rows with the referencing item expanded, newest first. Only references from the same organization are returned.

get.summary: Get detailed usage information (which content items reference this one)

200.description: One entry per referencing (item, field) pair, with a display title extracted from the referencing item. Empty when nothing uses this content.

get.summary: Check if content can be safely deleted (no incoming references)

200.description: Whether a plain (non-forced) delete would succeed, plus how many items reference this content.

put.summary: Set or remove parent for a content item

200.description: Acknowledgement. The `path` of this item and all its descendants is rebuilt as part of the call.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get direct children of a content item

200.description: Direct children as full content records, ordered by `sortOrder`, each with its content type reference and grandchild count.

get.summary: Get ancestor chain (breadcrumb trail) from root to parent

200.description: Ancestors in root-to-parent order; empty array for a root-level item. Capped at 50 levels as a cycle safeguard.

get.summary: Get hierarchical content tree (root-level items)

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Maximum depth to recurse (1 = direct children only)

200.description: Root-level nodes ordered by `sortOrder`. Nested `children` are populated only when `depth > 1`.

get.summary: Get content tree starting from a specific parent

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Maximum depth to recurse (1 = direct children only)

200.description: Direct children of the given parent ordered by `sortOrder`. Nested `children` are populated only when `depth > 1`.

post.summary: Move content within the tree (change parent and/or reorder)

200.description: Acknowledgement. Sibling `sortOrder` values are renumbered and the subtree `path` is rebuilt as part of the call.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get threaded comments for a content item

200.description: Top-level comments (newest first), each with its author and direct replies (oldest first).

get.summary: Get comment count for a content item

200.description: Total comment count, replies included. Scoped to the caller's organization.

post.summary: Create a comment on content (supports threaded replies)

201.description: The created comment with its author. Mention and reply notifications are dispatched asynchronously.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The updated comment. Only the author may edit; others get 403.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete a comment (own comments or admin can delete any)

200.description: Deletion acknowledgement. Replies to the comment are deleted with it.

post.summary: Resolve a comment thread (IMP-CONTENT-14)

200.description: The comment with `resolvedAt`/`resolvedById` stamped. Idempotent.

post.summary: Reopen a resolved comment thread

200.description: The comment with `resolvedAt`/`resolvedById` cleared.

get.summary: List registry-imported content types whose registry version is newer than the local one

200.description: Version comparison for every registry-backed content type, plus a count of the ones with an update available.

get.summary: Browse content types from the Schema Registry

200.description: The registry catalogue, proxied as-is. Optionally narrowed by `category` and `status`.

get.summary: List categories from the Schema Registry

200.description: Registry categories with the number of content types in each.

get.summary: Get category i18n labels

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

get.summary: Get i18n labels for a content type from the Schema Registry

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

get.summary: Get full detail for a registry content type (metadata + form + teaser schemas)

parameters.name: typeId
parameters.description: Content type ID in the registry

200.description: The three schema documents the registry serves for the type. `formSchema`/`teaserSchema` are null when the registry has none; a missing metadata schema is a 400.

post.summary: Import a content type from the Schema Registry into Studio

201.description: The content type as stored in Studio after the upsert. Default layouts are seeded as a best-effort side effect (a layout failure does not fail the import).

get.summary: Get ActivityPub mapping for a content type from the Schema Registry

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

get.summary: Check connectivity to the Schema Registry

200.description: Reachability of the configured Schema Registry, plus the URL that was probed.

get.summary: List all layouts for the organization

200.description: All layouts, ordered by content type then `sortOrder`. Inactive layouts are excluded unless `includeInactive=true`.

get.summary: Get layout by ID

200.description: The layout including its full layout/v1 definition.

get.summary: List layouts for a specific content type

200.description: Active layouts of the content type, ordered by `sortOrder`. Cached 2 min.

get.summary: Get default layout for a content type

200.description: The active default layout, or `null` when the content type has none marked default.

put.summary: Set default layout for a content type

200.description: The newly default layout. Any previous default of that content type is unset in the same transaction.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Sync layouts from Schema Registry for a content type

201.description: Sync counts. When the registry is unreachable or returns nothing, bundled defaults are seeded instead and `message` says so.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Validate a layout definition against the layout/v1 JSON Schema

201.description: Validation outcome — a malformed definition is reported in `data.errors`, not as an HTTP error.

post.summary: Resolve a layout against content data (for preview)

201.description: The layout with every region resolved against the posted content for the requested locale and breakpoint — ready to render.

get.summary: List all locale variants for a content item

200.description: All variants of the group, sorted by locale. When the item belongs to no variant group the array contains only the item itself.

get.summary: Get a specific locale variant

200.description: The variant content item, or `null` when no variant exists for that locale. Edge case: when the item has no variant group but its own locale matches, `data` is the content UUID as a bare string.

post.summary: Create a locale variant (copies data from source as starting point)

201.description: The newly created variant: status `draft`, version 1, slug `<source-slug>-<locale>`, data copied from the source.

post.summary: Sync a shared field value across all locale variants

201.description: How many sibling variants received the value. `synced: 0` plus a `message` when the item has no variant group or the field is absent from the source.

slug.description: A desired slug/title to normalise instead of deriving from data

fieldId.description: Field ID to sync across all locale variants

synced.description: Number of sibling variants that were updated

fieldId.description: The synced field id (absent when nothing was synced)

variantGroupId.description: The variant group the sync ran across (absent when nothing was synced)

message.description: Why nothing was synced — present instead of `fieldId`/`variantGroupId` when the item has no variant group or the field is missing from the source

force.description: Force re-sync even if version matches

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency token: the version the client loaded. If it no longer matches the stored version, the update is rejected with 409 (another editor changed the item first).

changeNote.description: Optional note describing this change; stored on the version history.

data.description: Updated content data. Creates a new version snapshot.

expiresAt.description: Content expiry time (ISO 8601), or null to clear (IMP-CONTENT-08).

formSchema.description: UI form layout schema for the content editor

teaserSchema.description: Teaser field mapping schema for Discovery Node publishing

contentTypeId.description: Content type id to validate against

data.description: Content data to validate against the type schema
